text:
𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗪𝗢𝗠𝗘𝗡, 𝗪𝗢𝗥𝗟𝗗 𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗠𝗣𝗜𝗢𝗡𝗦 🏆🇮🇳

India beat South Africa by 52 runs in Navi Mumbai on 2 Nov 2025.
Their first Women's World Cup title, after finals in 2005 and 2017. 💙

#Cricket #WomensWorldCup

👉 India ka pehla Women's World Cup khitaab
👉 2005 aur 2017 ke final ki kasak poori hui
